missing.fact: The probability mass for a proc on trial k is P(X_k) = (1-C)(1-2C)…(1-(k-1)C)kC = k!C∏_{i=1}^{k-1}(1/i-C).
Chaos Bolt has minimum damage 90/110/130/150, maximum damage 180/220/260/300, minimum stun duration 1.25/1.5/1.75/2 (2.25/2.5/2.75/3), and maximum stun duration 2.2/2.8/3.4/4 (3.2/3.8/4.4/5).
Doppelganger uses random positions within its target area; the calculation may use polar coordinates with a 0–360° angle and 0–325 distance units as the minimum/maximum gradients.
Freezing Field's angle may be random within each of four 90° sectors: 0°–90°, 90°–180°, 180°–270°, and 270°–360°.
Battery Assault has 16 (24) shrapnels, a 275 search radius, and a 0.7-second (0.45-second) interval.
Dark Willow's Bedlam is a discrete random event with a 300 attack radius and 0.25-second attack interval.

Shadow Wave has 3/4/5/6 bounces and a 475 bounce distance. It prioritizes heroes over other units and injured allies over non-injured allies, choosing randomly when multiple units meet the same criteria.
Exorcism has a 700 search radius. Its spirits choose targets randomly, remain with the chosen target until they can no longer attack it, and prioritize units attacked by the caster.
Ember Spirit's Searing Chains is a discrete random event with a maximum of 2 targets and a 400 search radius.
Sleight of Fist has an effect radius of 250/350/450/550 and a 0.2-second attack interval; targets are determined upon cast, and their attack order is random.

Nature's Attendants has 4/6/8/10 (12/14/16/18) wisps, a 275 search radius, a 1-second interval, and a 10-second duration. Every second each wisp randomly chooses an allied unit to heal, allowing as many allies to be healed simultaneously as there are wisps.
Rocket Barrage fires 10 rockets per second, with a 400 search radius, 0.1 interval, and 3 duration.
Harpy Stormcrafter's Chain Lightning is a discrete random event with 4 bounces, a 500 bounce distance, and a 0.25-second interval.
Juggernaut's Omnislash is a discrete random event with a 1.7 attack-rate divisor and 425 search radius; it slashes enemies based on Juggernaut's attack rate.
Leshrac's Diabolic Edict is a discrete random event with 40 (80) explosions, a 500 search radius, and a 0.25-second (0.13-second) interval.
Chain Frost has 10 (Infinite) bounces, a 575 bounce distance, and a 0.2-second interval.
Lion's Mana Drain is a discrete random event with maximum targets 1 (3) and search radius 0 (400).
Eclipse has 6/9/12 (6/12/18) beams, a 675 search radius, and a 0.6-second (0.3-second) interval.

Morphling's Adaptive Strike (Agility) has maximum targets 1 (4) and search radius 900/1000/1100/1200. Its talent upgrade releases three extra projectiles that hit a second, third, and fourth random enemy within the radius.

Morphling's Adaptive Strike (Strength) has maximum targets 1 (4) and search radius 900/1000/1100/1200. Its talent upgrade releases three extra projectiles that hit a second, third, and fourth random enemy within the radius.
Ignite has multicast amounts 1/2/3, a 1400 multicast range, and a 0.4-second interval.
Bloodlust has multicast amounts 1/2/3 and a 700 search radius.

Phantom Assassin's Stifling Dagger is a discrete random event with maximum targets 1 (3) and search radius 825/1050/1275/1500. Its talent upgrade releases two extra projectiles that hit a second and third random enemy within the radius.
Razor's Eye of the Storm is a discrete random event with a 500 search radius. It chooses randomly when multiple enemies have equal health or when multiple heroes are linked with Static Link.
Tricks of the Trade has a 450 search radius, 4 (5) attacks, and a maximum channel time of 2.
Shadow Shaman's Mass Serpent Ward has maximum targets 1 (2) and search radius 0 (875). Aghanim's Scepter makes each attack release a second attack against a random second enemy within the radius.

Skywrath Mage's Arcane Bolt has maximum targets 1 (2) (2, 3) and search radius 0 (700) (700). A talent or Aghanim's Scepter adds a second or third projectile against a second or third random enemy within the radius.
Skywrath Mage's Concussive Shot has maximum targets 1 (2) and search radius 0 (700, Global). Aghanim's Scepter adds a second projectile against a random second enemy within the radius.
Skywrath Mage's Ancient Seal has maximum targets 1 (2) and search radius 0 (700). Aghanim's Scepter makes it target a random second enemy within the radius.
Skywrath Mage's Mystic Flare has 1 (2) flares and search radius 0 (700). Aghanim's Scepter creates a second flare on a random enemy within the radius.
Visage's Soul Assumption has maximum targets 1 (2) and search radius 1200 (1325). Its talent upgrade releases a second projectile against a random second enemy within the radius.
Paralyzing Cask has 2/4/6/8 (4/6/8/10) bounces, a 575 bounce distance, and a 0.3-second interval.
Storm's Drunken Brawler and Mirana's Moonlight Shadow require talents to serve as the listed evasion sources.

The omitted PRD-based effects are Brewmaster's Drunken Brawler (Fire Stance), Lycan's Wolf Bite, Lycan Wolf's Cripple, Ogre Magi's Fireblast (requires a talent), Troll Warlord's Berserker's Rage, Abyssal Blade's Bash, and Mjollnir's Static Charge.
Faceless Void's Backtrack requires a talent.
